description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Average Performance." It uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines spaced at intervals of 10. The chart contains five distinct vertical bars, each assigned a unique color. The first bar, labeled Standard, is orange and has an approximate value of 53. The second bar, Self-RAG, is dark beige and reaches about 54. The third bar, FactTune, is yellow-green and represents the lowest value on the chart at approximately 52. The fourth bar, CInGS (w/), is steel blue with a value near 54. The final bar, CInGS, is bright blue and represents the highest value, reaching approximately 59. The bars are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, and there are no visual annotations or specific emphasis applied to any individual bar beyond their distinct colors.
